patch_description:
The previous edit failed because the SEARCH block did not match the file exactly and/or the replacement code was incomplete. This attempt replaces the solve() stub inside the evolve block with a complete, self-contained, deterministic optimizer:

1. Construction region: a unit-area equilateral triangle (area exactly 1), so all points automatically satisfy the unit-area convex region constraint.
2. Initialization: 3-fold rotationally symmetric configurations (center + 4 orbits of 3 points = 13 points), which matches the known symmetry bias of good Heilbronn configurations and reduces the search to 10 parameters.
3. Optimization stage 1: seeded simulated annealing over the 10 symmetry parameters (center x,y plus radius/angle per orbit), maximizing min triangle area / convex hull area (exactly the graded metric).
4. Optimization stage 2: greedy coordinate-descent polish of all 13 free points with a shrinking step size, projected back into the triangle via barycentric clipping, to fine-tune the symmetric solution.
5. Determinism: fixed numpy Generator seed, no platform-dependent randomness; objective evaluated with vectorized numpy over all 286 triples, so runtime stays well within limits.
6. Error handling: the whole procedure is wrapped in try/except with a safe triangular-lattice fallback configuration.

Min-area is computed over all C(13,3)=286 triangles and normalized by the actual convex hull area of the returned points, matching the scoring function, so the annealing directly optimizes the reported metric (target > 1.0 × benchmark).
